title: UK retro-game retailers — stock-sourcing prospect profiles
criteria: Eight distinct UK retailer records: one free example, five additional paid profiles and two reserves. Every selected retailer publishes retro-game buying or trade activity and a business contact. Match any sourcing trial to its own platform, region, condition and delivered-cost requirements.

leads.business_need: Purchases vintage games and consoles through photo-led valuation. Its trade page distinguishes tested and untested hardware, original boxes/manuals, disc wear and cartridge save batteries.
leads.contact_instructions: Published general business email; ask for the buying team. Contact page also lists 07850 856585.
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: BuyHub saved terms and listing filters could support a retailer-selected console category while staff retain condition, completeness and delivered cost. Existing sourcing software and interest are unknown.
leads.opening_message: Your trade-in guide keeps boxed completeness, working condition and save batteries separate when valuing stock. Would your buying team consider comparing actual listings for one platform you already buy, using BuyHub saved searches with region and condition kept visible?
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Agree one platform and actual purchase limits. Separate PAL and other releases, original/replacement packaging, working/untested units and shipping costs. Staff still verify every listing; published marketplace alternatives do not establish the shop’s own buying tools.

leads.business_need: Independent shop explicitly buys, sells and trades retro and modern games/consoles. Its stocked platforms include Mega Drive, PlayStation, SNES, Nintendo 64 and Game Boy.
leads.contact_instructions: Published shop email. Opening times can vary with collections/events; current site directs visitors to its Facebook notice.
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: One currently accepted platform could be compared through BuyHub saved searches with separate boxed/loose and region/condition terms. Existing collection and trade activity supplies the business fit.
leads.opening_message: You buy and trade across Mega Drive, PlayStation, SNES and Game Boy alongside the Havant shop. Would a BuyHub comparison for one platform you are actively buying be useful, with separate saved terms for boxed and loose copies and your own region and delivered-price limits?
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Confirm currently wanted stock, countries and acceptable faults. Catalogue listings are not an active replenishment request. Super Games World in the same site footer is an alias of this one profile; current software, budget and interest are unknown.

leads.business_need: Buys Nintendo/Sega consoles and games from individual items to entire collections. Named wanted formats include NES, SNES, N64, GameCube, Game Boy, Saturn and Dreamcast; travels nationwide for larger or rarer collections.
leads.contact_instructions: Published shop email and 07494 006888. Current shop:66 Station Road, New Milton BH25 6LE.
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: A reviewed BuyHub watchlist could support one wanted console family, keeping seller location and collection/delivery cost visible alongside its existing collection-buying service.
leads.opening_message: Your wanted list includes Nintendo and Sega collections, and you travel for larger or rarer lots. Would a BuyHub saved-search trial for one console family help your team compare actual collection listings by country, contents and total collection or delivery cost?
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Keep the trial on the explicitly wanted video-game range; the shop also buys toys. Agree region, testing, missing-accessory and travel limits. Import policy and available buying budget have not been established.

leads.business_need: Its public contact page advertises buying individual retro games through complete collections. The shop offers Nintendo, Sega and PlayStation games, consoles and accessories.
leads.contact_instructions: Published shop email and WhatsApp07542899495. Indexed contact source gives Unit13 Steelbox Works, Canklow Meadows Industrial Estate, Rotherham; no owner name inferred.
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: BuyHub could compare one staff-selected stock category across supported marketplaces with location, platform and described condition kept separate.
leads.opening_message: Your Rotherham shop buys individual retro games and whole collections. Would your buying team consider a BuyHub saved-search comparison for one platform you currently source, with region, condition and total delivered cost recorded before reviewing listings?
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Official indexed contact/shop text supports this record; direct fetches timed out. Re-open the public contact page before outreach. Confirm accepted formats and PAL/import requirements; current sourcing software, purchase need and budget are unknown.

leads.business_need: The Derby shop buys, sells and trades retro games and consoles, offers collection for larger lots, and describes cleaning/testing controllers. Its catalogue separately labels a PAL Super Mario Kart set and a Japanese-import Sega Saturn bundle. Both example listings were marked out of stock when read.
leads.contact_instructions: Public buying, selling and trade enquiries. The published trade route accepts email enquiries and advertises a collection service for larger groups of items. No appointment, active purchasing request or account relationship is assumed.
leads.published_budget: No software or sourcing budget published.
leads.why_it_fits: A BuyHub trial could keep UK/PAL software searches separate from explicitly selected Japanese hardware, using saved terms, country filters and auction alerts. Staff would review complete-box condition, authenticity, included accessories and landed cost before deciding. The two catalogue examples demonstrate distinct product categories; their stock status is not evidence of a restocking request.
leads.opening_message: Your PAL SNES and Japanese Saturn catalogue entries show why region and completeness need to stay visible when sourcing retro stock. Would your buying team consider a BuyHub trial for one category you already purchase, with separate saved searches and a review of actual listings?
leads.status_note: Public buying/trade activity checked on 13 October 2026. Confirm the shop's currently accepted formats, whether it wants UK-only sourcing or imports, boxed/manual requirements, testing standard and acceptable repairs/modifications. Its Japanese Saturn page specifies a step-down converter for UK use; retain that as an item-specific requirement and verify every proposed console separately. Ask the retailer to set purchase limits and shipping/import assumptions. No current sourcing software, margin, budget or buying intent is known. The first-party site presents one local Derby shop and identifies Retro World as its owner; legal ownership and wider group structure have not been independently established.
